entities.name: Codex Mosquensis I
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Codex Mosquensis I designated by Kap or 018, Απρ1 (Soden), is a Greek uncial manuscript of New Testament, palaeographically it has been assigned to the 9th century. The manuscript is lacunose.
